design.source_policy: restricted exact-source metadata digit derivation only, exclude 144 previous source hashes/paths and 36 new replay/gate/exam sources from 64 new crystal sources; two disjoint groups of 32
design.crystals: source alias, derived last_digit property, exact verified value, source SHA256, registry commit/path, field pointer digest; source alias determined from hash, not answer; stratified selection independent of model scores
design.comparison: two shared natural forms, two plain vs two structured JSON/triple prefixes; same supervised targets, sampling, token positions and replay; paired CE versus full-vocab CE versus full-vocab structured CE
design.open_exam: greedy single next byte across entire 258-token vocabulary, two novel natural prompt forms per trained source alias; no answer options, retrieval or teacher in candidate forward
design.preservation: both pairwise and full-vocab parent-correct item veto and exact rollback; both new gate losses <= parent; final separate old item exam
design.gate: >=20/32 exact both forms, net gain >=4, zero old pair and open item losses, >=16 old paired parent correct, >=5 distinct digits predicted per form

limits: New scoped admission of factual metadata-derived last-digit associations, not full raw document training or scientific truth
JSON prefixes and triple prefixes teach structure; no proof of complete JSON generation
Single-token open generation, not full autonomous natural-language output
Same source identities used during training and held-out wording exam, not unseen-source inference; same-process scoring, no independently administered blind or network-isolation proof
Cortex corpus only used for source preparation, not candidate exam inference; candidate and parent weights frozen before final prompts
No promotion, export, production change or quarantine override
